editorial.blurb: A beloved family-run gem where owner Irma and her team serve authentic, lovingly prepared Mexican food with genuine warmth in an intimate hole-in-the-wall setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early or be prepared to wait—all six tables fill quickly—and don't miss the complimentary sopa de caracol welcome appetizer and the house-made Mango Habanero sauce that guests rave about.
